name: Fraxinus

project_scope.selection_mode: B014 strict review + B143 source-status reconciliation
project_scope.note: F. berlandieriana and F. greggii completed independent review but remain user-accepted unresolved range HOLDs. Genus-level processing can be complete without installing them.

study_strategy.warning: In Central Texas, do not identify ashes from leaf silhouette alone. Use leaflet undersides, scars, and especially samaras; historical confusion among F. albicans, F. pennsylvanica, and F. berlandieriana is well documented.

quick_key.if: 5–7 leaflets + glaucous/white-reticulate wax below + small samara with mostly terminal wing
5–7(9) leaflets + broader shield-shaped scar + larger samara with wing extending well down body
usually 3–5 leaflets with coarse sharp distal serration + samara wings gradually expanding from near base; occasional 3-winged fruits
xeric shrub/small tree with tiny thick leathery leaflets, often only 3 per leaf, on rocky slopes/washes

source_concept_status.note: Travis and Comal firm; third exact target-zone county not locked.
Val Verde firm; fewer than three exact target-zone counties locked.

look_here_first: Confirm opposite twigs and pinnately compound leaves; then compare samara wing attachment, underside leaflet wax, leaf scars, and leaflet size.

comparison_matrix.pennsylvanica: Larger body, wing extending down body
comparison_matrix.berlandieriana: Wings expand gradually near base; occasional 3-winged fruit
comparison_matrix.greggii: Winged samara; precise comparison needs review

overlap_cautions: Leaflet counts overlap; compare multiple mature leaves and fruits.
Range status and canonical installation are separate; preserve existing range reviews.
Young or damaged twigs can obscure leaf-scar distinctions.
diagnostic_photo_checklist: Matched lower leaflet surfaces with scale and wax detail
Samara wing/body junction of each species at same scale
Winter twig scars with bud position
Leaflet count and serration of mature leaves
Gregg's ash small leathery leaves versus tree ashes
